preconditions.description: The number of lamps n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each index a_i of the main lamp for the i-th wire is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The input list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1} corresponds to a valid garland scheme.
preconditions.description: The list of main lamp indices can be used to reconstruct a garland scheme.

postconditions.expression: The output contains one integer k, the index of the lamp connected to the power grid.
postconditions.description: The output must include the index of the lamp connected to the power grid.

postconditions.expression: The output contains n - 1 lines, each with two integers x_i and y_i, representing a wire between lamps x_i and y_i.
postconditions.description: The output must include all wires in the garland scheme, with each wire connecting two lamps.

postconditions.expression: The output must correspond to a valid garland scheme that could have produced the input list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1}.
postconditions.description: The output must be a valid garland scheme that can be used to generate the input list of main lamp indices.

postconditions.expression: If it is impossible to restore the original scheme, print -1.
postconditions.description: If the input list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1} does not correspond to a valid garland scheme, the output must be -1.

invariants.expression: The lamp connected to the power grid is the one with the lowest index not in the list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1}.
invariants.description: The lamp connected to the power grid is the first lamp not listed as a main lamp.

invariants.expression: Each wire connects two lamps, and each lamp is connected by at most one wire.
invariants.description: Each lamp has at most one incoming wire, and each wire connects exactly two lamps.

invariants.expression: The list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n-1} must be consistent with the scheme described by the output.
invariants.description: The list of main lamp indices must be consistent with the wiring scheme described by the output.
